verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents registrable outbound HTTP webhooks or an event stream that external systems can subscribe to for sign-ups, sign-ins, or user changes. What it does show is adjacent: database triggers that connect auth data to your own tables, and Postgres-function auth hooks that customize behavior at lifecycle points. These are building blocks for customization, not an event-subscription capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to webhooks or event streams for auth events (sign-ups, sign-ins, user changes) to keep my systems in sync
